name: wheel-carousel
title: Wheel Carousel
description: Vertical curved list of names on a wheel; the photo beside it crossfades to the selected item. Scroll, drag or arrow keys.
darkMode: mode prop: light | dark | system | custom (system needs a next-themes ThemeProvider; without it shows light)
mainProps: items: {label, image, imageAlt?}[], mode, photoSide, photoWidth, photoAspect, textColor, selectedColor, markerColor, background, activeIndex, onActiveChange
